        "All 3,643 lines of the 18-path owned diff were read, including every emitted type change. Author-owned generator/runtime/pagination tests and generated JSON bindings remain functional scope; generated comments and layout do not establish global source style. Exact NUL paths and accepted ancestry checked; no Suite path/directive matches found in the scoped Rust paths.",
        "The original generator splits instantiated_type from return_type: setter arguments retain collection/nullable wrappers and owned strings, while getter results keep Result except inherited references. MethodDef emits consuming mut self setters returning Self, marks them must_use and sorts getter/setter pairs by getter name. The nullable/array reviewer objection is addressed by arg_type using instantiated_type, and emitted Vec<Recipient<'_>>/Option<String> signatures confirm actual output.",
        "Original PropertyMap wraps Cow<Map<String,Value>>. Empty constructors use Default. Setters call to_mut: inherited custom views append flattened properties, named custom values insert a JSON object, custom collections convert each element into an object, and scalar/primitive collections use Into<Value>. Borrowed getters wrap the same map via PropertyMap/From instead of the former private constructor. These are local JSON transformations, not proof of remote writability.",
        "Every generated setter explicitly disclaims Graph writability, including Entity::set_id and User fields whose getter docs say read-only. The schema does not filter setters based on prose descriptions. Retained primary/review rationale must remain distinct from API authorization or server acceptance.",
        "Tests only adjust existing raw-map expected values in lib.rs and pagination.rs to wrap PropertyMap; no constructor/setter roundtrip, inherited collision or remote write assertion is added. Existing assert_eq! messages in these unchanged assertion lines are absent; they are contextual existing sites, not newly introduced assertions. No setter test execution is inferred from compilation/report history.",
        "Manual source review: generator comments explain nullable cast/error and pair-order constraints. Separate steps and early inherited guard are readable. The misspellings propeperty/inhereted predate this source phase or persist in reused template prose; they are not naming policy. Imported schema doc prose and generated formatting are excluded from local style guidance.",
        "At fixed accepted revision the generator is oxidize/structs.rs and emits public typed fields, serde(default/rename_all) and skip_serializing_none instead of PropertyMap/method setters. Current MailFolder uses Option<Nullable<T>> and the actual accepted consumer constructs display_name with notnull! plus Default. Preserve the original consuming-setter phase separately; do not prescribe it to current callers.",
        "Full primary Bug 2025550 current comments 0–2, activity and end controls read from the exact A original. Author says the shared request/response schema exposes fields that do not all affect creation; that is rationale for constructors, not independent server-contract verification. Dependencies 2008857/2018998 remain unread.",
        "Full D289659 creation-to-final timeline and five actual submitted bodies were read during C collection. The reviewer asks for chaining and custom types, then rejects incorrect array/nullable argument shapes. Original arg_type/instantiated_type and emitted Vec/Option setters establish adoption; consuming self rather than &mut self is explicit in both discussion and code. The inline quote-layout suggestion is applied in setter_body. Read-only-description filtering is discussed and declined in favor of consumer responsibility. Potential forbidden trait-method names remain a later proposal; the source still generates set_from and uses Into for conversions.",
        "The reviewer reports mostly-working local testing with an argument issue; author reports a Try atop the folder-creation patch. These are historical reports. No new tests, compiler or generated-code execution; source-stage pending-discussion wording in the preserved original is historical and this full join resolves the required context."
